name: Zabvennye miry
source:
The events of this story take place after Lena’s good ending. The characters leave the camp on a bus and arrive in the city.

Together, they slowly begin to adjust to this new world. Semyon throws himself into work, hoping to finally realize his potential, while Lena devotes herself to what she truly loves.

Then, just when everything seems peaceful, Lena suddenly leaves home and simultaneously vanishes from the memories of everyone who ever knew her. Only Semyon can remember the woman he spent those few years of his life with.

What could this be? A family quarrel? A kidnapping? Or something far more mysterious?

Could the camp be involved again? Did it even truly exist?

Step by step, the protagonist will delve into a series of strange events that led to Lena’s disappearance. Semyon will have to journey through many new worlds and stories. Along the way, he will begin to see his own life and the lives of those he meets in a whole new light.
translation:
这个故事的事件发生在莉娜的美好结局之后。角色们乘坐公共汽车离开营地并到达城市。

他们一起慢慢开始适应这个新世界。谢苗全身心投入工作，希望最终实现自己的潜力，而莉娜则致力于她真正热爱的事情。

然后，就在一切看似平静的时候，莉娜突然离开了家，同时从所有认识她的人的记忆中消失了。只有谢苗还记得那个和他一起度过那几年的女人。

这可能是什么？家庭争吵？绑架？或者还有更神秘的东西？

阵营会再次参与吗？它真的存在吗？

主角将一步步探究导致莉娜失踪的一系列奇怪事件。谢苗将不得不经历许多新的世界和故事。一路上，他将开始以全新的眼光看待自己的生活以及他遇到的人的生活。
